method: Count dependency-unblocked READY opportunities with no exclusive claim after exact claim-path recheck.
other_active_worker_not_counted_as_free_: O-PROGRESS-METRICS-COMPILER-V1 remains STARTED; if it later performs POST_RETURN it must race normally and cannot reserve a generated opportunity in advance.
collision_rule: If an existing worker claims one before a fresh worker, the loser reloads and takes the next compatible READY item; no manual reassignment required.
